```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

library(MuSiC)
library(SingleCellExperiment)
library(DESeq2)
library(tximport)
library(rtracklayer)
library(tidyverse)


```

## Load Data

Load bulk transcriptomic data
```{r}

dds = readRDS("ec_bulk_dds_obj.rds")

```

Load gene_info metadata for bulk transcriptomic data
```{r}

gene_info = readRDS("ec_gene_info.rds")

```

Create Single-Cell Reference Object
- source of matrix =
```{r}

#get matrix
ref_matrix = read.csv("hpf_v3_ref_mat.csv")

#set index
rownames(ref_matrix) = ref_matrix$cell_label
ref_matrix$cell_label = NULL

#add metadata
ref_meta = read.csv("hpf_v3_ref_metadata.csv")
ref_meta$X = NULL

rownames(ref_meta) = ref_meta$cell_label

# create reference
sce <- SingleCellExperiment(assays = list(counts = t(ref_matrix)), 
                               colData = ref_meta)

```


### Prepare SCE Object

```{r Reference Expression Matrix Creation}

# Convert colData to a data frame
sceframe <- as.data.frame(colData(sce))

#create single-cell reference
assay_data <- as.matrix(assay(sce))

# Convert colData and rowData to standard data frames
pheno_data <- as.data.frame(colData(sce))
pheno_data$cellType <- pheno_data$cell_type
#pheno_data$SubjectName <- pheno_data$cell_label
pheno_data$SubjectName <- pheno_data$donor_label
feature_data <- as.data.frame(rowData(sce))

# Create ExpressionSet
eset <- ExpressionSet(assayData = assay_data,
                      phenoData = new("AnnotatedDataFrame", data = pheno_data),
                      featureData = new("AnnotatedDataFrame", data = feature_data))
```


## Run Bulk De-convolution Via MuSiC

```{r, use_music}


#eset_Bulk = expression set of our bulk data
#sce = single cell experiment object of our data


# Extract raw counts
raw_counts <- counts(dds, normalized = FALSE)
rownames(raw_counts) <- ifelse(
   rownames(raw_counts) %in% gene_info$gene_name,
   gene_info$gene_id,
    rownames(raw_counts))

head(rownames(raw_counts))

colnames(raw_counts) = c("intEC S1", "intEC S2", "intEC S3","LEC S1", "LEC S2", "LEC S3","MEC S1","MEC S2","MEC S3")

# Use the function for reference-based deconvolution
eset_Bulk <- ExpressionSet(assayData = as.matrix(raw_counts))


# Bulk expression matrix
bulk.mtx = exprs(eset_Bulk)

# Estimate cell type proportions
est.prop.ec = music_prop(bulk.mtx = bulk.mtx, sc.eset = eset, sc.sce = sce, clusters = 'supertype',
                               samples = 'donor_label', verbose = F)

print(est.prop.ec$Est.prop.weighted)

```


## Generate Figure

```{r, music_weighted}

#Turn results into dataFrame
deconv_data <- as.data.frame(t(est.prop.ec$Est.prop.weighted))

#Run always
deconv_data$CellType <- rownames(deconv_data)
deconv_long <- pivot_longer(deconv_data, cols = -CellType, names_to = "Sample", values_to = "Proportion")
deconv_long$Region <- sub(" .*", "", deconv_long$Sample)


deconv_long$Region <- factor(deconv_long$Region, levels = c("MEC", "intEC", "LEC"))
deconv_long$CellType <- factor(deconv_long$CellType,
                               levels = c("0007 L5/6 IT TPE-ENT Glut_1","0008 L5/6 IT TPE-ENT Glut_2" ,
                                          "0010 L5/6 IT TPE-ENT Glut_4" ,"0129 NP PPP Glut_1"))

# Customize colors (use your preferred colors)
custom_colors <- c("0007 L5/6 IT TPE-ENT Glut_1" = "orange",
                   "0008 L5/6 IT TPE-ENT Glut_2" = "#F7D379",
                   "0010 L5/6 IT TPE-ENT Glut_4" = "#619196",
                   "0129 NP PPP Glut_1" = "#F1B3A1")

# Create the plot with faceting, custom colors, and horizontal bars with a percentage x-axis
cell <- ggplot(deconv_long, aes(x = Proportion, y = Sample, fill = CellType)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "fill", color = "white", alpha = 0.95) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = custom_colors) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::percent) + # Use a percentage format on the x-axis
  labs(x = "Estimated Cell Supertype Proportions (%)", y = NULL, fill = "Supertype") +
  # Add labels only if Proportion is greater than 0%
  #geom_text(
  #aes(label = ifelse(Proportion > 0.005, scales::percent(Proportion, accuracy = 1), "")),
  #position = position_fill(vjust = 0.5), size = 7) +
  facet_wrap(~ Region, scales = "free_y", ncol = 1) + # Facet by Region with one column
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "right",
    strip.text = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"), # Increase size and bold for facet strip labels
    panel.spacing = unit(1, "lines"),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 13, face = "bold"), # Make x-axis title bold and larger
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold"),  # Make x-axis text bold and larger
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold")   # Adjust y-axis title size if needed
  )

print(cell)


```
